understood_as: User approved M/L scale follow-up, thirty new jobs from fresh normal pretraining. Keep teacher width and all learning/environment contracts fixed; reuse completed S without retraining or checkpoint widening.
training: Normal fixed normal12 pretraining without initial waits, then same full pretrained state cloned into q0/q.1 delivery adaptation. Adaptation uses unchanged uniform integer0..8 initial waits outside learner buffer and separate kernel/delay RNG. 64 tick world limit includes waits. Preserve masked post-delivery padding and global BC512..4608.

inherited_contract.lifecycle: Both adaptation branches command delivery at the pretrained world reset boundary. Kernel is Bernoulli(q) fixed, otherwise mutant, sampled only at world reset and held within that world. Delay is applied once at initial attachment and each world reset, not goal switches. Dedicated seed-derived kernel and delay streams are reproducible across branches and independent of learner RNG.
inherited_contract.discount: Learning uses the unchanged per-collector-step discount and GAE; no forced-wait transition is inserted into either learner. Evaluated discounted return includes physical waiting ticks. Waits start at tick0 with no carried item, last at most12 evaluation ticks, and cannot succeed or time out before policy control.
inherited_contract.bc: Coefficient0.1 at global update0, linear to0 at4608; adaptation starts global512 at0.0888889, no restart. Last applied update uses global4607; coefficient at completed checkpoint4608 is0.
inherited_contract.evaluation: Evaluation preserves full learner state including RNG and normalization. Mode1/sample8 repeats per layout per adaptation condition. One-shot block applies fixed wall collision only on the first attempted mutant wall crossing, then reverts to mutant. Success is delivery by64 ticks; wall-pass is any actual wall crossing, independent of success. Control length is total physical episode length minus forced waits, including unsuccessful episodes. Group10,12 weights both delays equally within each learner.
inherited_contract.recovery: Resume the same seed at its latest integrity-verified full checkpoint after a recoverable interruption; no replacement seed or automatic budget extension. Incomplete checkpoint files are preserved and included in measured disk usage, not treated as resumable checkpoints.

fixed_contract: CNN unchanged; shared dense, actor2 and critic4 widths scale together. PPO lr2e-4 constant, epoch1, minibatch1024, entropy.005, gamma.995, GAE.95; teacher width512 and original learning contract. Learned teacher states may differ with policy experience.
order: For each seed, M pretraining and both branches, then L pretraining and both branches. No result-dependent switching, dropping or extensions.
failures: Run every registered seed and branch if numerically executable. Report final natural fixed pretraining mode/sample success; >=90% in both is a descriptive normal-capability flag, not a seed filter or stopping gate. Numerical/integrity/storage failure halts with evidence and is not replaced by another seed.

evaluation.pretrain: Original evaluator: both kernels,16 layouts, mode1/sample64, natural starts, five checkpoints. Evaluation never changes learner state.
evaluation.adaptation: Exactly reuse S evaluator:11 delays0..8,10,12 x fixed/mutant/one-shot block x16 layouts x(mode1+sample8), at eight checkpoints.
evaluation.primary: Final4096 mode per size,q,seed,individual delay and groups0 /1..8 /10,12; mutant success,wall-pass,post-wait control length jointly with fixed success; paired same-policy kernel discounted return. Report sample and one-shot block separately.
evaluation.interpretation: 10/12 are previously observed failure points: follow-up confirmation, not newly discovered holdouts. Five existing paired seed labels, not new independent-seed replication. Failures remain in denominator; normal capability loss cannot be called better bug avoidance.

smoke.M_L: Each width: normal update twice, q0 and q.1 delayed adaptation update twice each; full-state in-memory serialization restore parity, finite states and counters. Adaptation smoke uses fresh disposable weights with global schedule set to512, not pretrained scientific checkpoints.
smoke.S: Exact fresh initialization against historic update0; commanded delayed state against saved S adapt0; same existing full-update contract.
